sources.note: The record's official_source_url. BME's own 'Scholarships' page under International; it describes outbound mobility funding for current BME students (350+ partner universities), not an inbound scholarship.

BME's scholarships page for applicants (the URL itself carries a typo, 'scolarships'). Lists Hungarian state scholarships for foreign students - Stipendium Hungaricum, Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship, Scholarship for Christian Young People, Students at Risk - with Stipendium Hungaricum funding details. No BME-run inbound scholarship.
BME application and admission page: students may come 'with a scholarship or as a self-funded student, by paying tuition fees'; 150 EUR application fee; no scholarship deadline stated.

Stipendium Hungaricum apply page (Tempus Public Foundation). Publishes the 2026/27 call and its timeline with the application deadline of 15th January 2026, 2 pm (CET) and a results step dated June 2026 - the cycle is closed.

Hungarian-language counterpart of the /en/scholarships page; opens with 'Kulfoldi mobilitasi lehetosegeket keresel?' ('Looking for foreign mobility opportunities?'), confirming the record's URL is the outbound mobility page.

awarding_body.detail: The page at the record's URL is genuinely BME's own, but it is the outbound mobility page for current BME students. BME operates no inbound scholarship of its own; the inbound scholarships it lists are Hungarian state programmes, and the one matching this record (15 January deadline, 'tuition fees and living expenses' funding) is Stipendium Hungaricum, awarded by the Hungarian Government and managed by Tempus Public Foundation, with BME merely one host institution among many.
awarding_body.quote: The Stipendium Hungaricum Programme is supervised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and managed by the Tempus Public Foundation.

deadline.detail: The record's '15 January 2026, 2:00 p.m. CET' matches, almost word for word, the Stipendium Hungaricum 2026/27 application deadline on the programme's apply page - but that cycle closed on 15 January 2026 (the published timeline puts results in June 2026), so it is not a currently open deadline. No BME page states any scholarship deadline, and as of 2026-10-12 no 2027/28 call with a new deadline has been published.
deadline.quote: 15th January 2026, 2 pm (CET) APPLICATION DEADLINE Your application must be submitted by the deadline.

eligibility.detail: The record's eligibility summary holds: the URL in the record is aimed at current BME students seeking outbound mobility, and BME publishes no inbound BME scholarship with readable eligibility criteria - the only inbound routes on bme.hu are Hungarian state programmes for foreign students. I could not independently verify the sub-claim that the current-scholarships index targets enrolled students 'many of whom must be Hungarian citizens' beyond confirming that both scholarship index pages (EN and HU) are the outbound mobility pages; the underlying nki.bme.hu listing was not read.
eligibility.quote: We're here to help if you're looking for international mobility opportunities.

funding.detail: Funding is not 'Unclear': BME's applicants' scholarships page spells out the Stipendium Hungaricum package in detail - no tuition fee, a monthly stipend, dormitory place or accommodation contribution, and health insurance - i.e. a fully funded award, but one awarded by the Hungarian state, not by BME. No BME-funded inbound scholarship exists for the record's 'Unclear' funding to refer to.
funding.quote:
The program offers:
- no tuition fee
- monthly stipend
- for BA/BSc, MA/MSc and one-tier master level programs: HUF 43,700/month (cca EUR 135) *contribution to the living expenses* in Hungary, for 12 months a year, until the completion of studies
- for doctoral programs: HUF 140,000 /month (cca EUR 450) for the first phase of education (4 semesters) and HUF 180 000 (cca EUR 580) for the second phase (4 semesters), for 12 months a year, until completion of studies
- dormitory place or additional contribution to accomodation costs
- health care services according to the relevant Hungarian legislation (Act No. 80 of 1997, national health insurance card) and supplementary medical insurance for up to HUF 65 000 (cca EUR 205) a year/person

degree_levels.detail: Consistent with the record. The programme the record's details actually belong to (Stipendium Hungaricum) covers bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's and non-degree programmes plus doctoral programmes, and BME's outbound page (the record's URL context) adds that scholarships exist 'even for those looking to expand their postgraduate studies'.
degree_levels.quote: You can find here the new call for applications and related information for bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's and non-degree programmes 2026/2027.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: "15th January 2026, 2 pm (CET)" - Stipendium Hungaricum 2026/27 application deadline; this deadline has passed and no 2027/28 deadline is published as of 2026-10-12
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-checked live 2026-10-12. The record's official_source_url (bme.hu/en/scholarships) is BME's outbound mobility page for enrolled BME students; BME's inbound scholarships page sits at the misspelled URL bme.hu/en/scolarships. No BME-awarded inbound scholarship exists - bme.hu lists only Hungarian state programmes (Stipendium Hungaricum, Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship, Scholarship for Christian Young People, Students at Risk). The record's deadline and funding wording come from Stipendium Hungaricum, a Hungarian Government programme managed by Tempus Public Foundation (BME is one host institution). The SH 2026/27 call closed 15 Jan 2026 14:00 CET; the next call was not yet published at check time (historically opens ~November, deadline mid-January). Do not present the record as an open BME award without human re-attribution.

notes_for_reviewer: The record conflates a host institution with an awarding body: everything verifiable in it (15 Jan 2026 14:00 CET deadline; tuition-free + stipend + accommodation + insurance package) belongs to Stipendium Hungaricum, awarded by the Hungarian Government and managed by Tempus Public Foundation, not to BME. A human must decide: either re-attribute the record to Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary; awarding body Tempus Public Foundation / Hungarian Government; BME as host institution) or quarantine it as a non-existent BME award. As of the check date the SH apply page still displays only the 2026/27 call, so the 2027/28 call should be re-checked around November 2026.
